sentences.text:
The aforesaid reliefs have been prayed on the premise that the petitioners' immovable properties comprising of land and commercial structures erected thereon came under the road widening,
namely, Delhi-Amritsar- Katra Expressway in respect whereof, the respondents 1 to 4 herein had undertaken acquisition proceedings under in terms of provisions of National Highway Act, 1956,
however, the respondents 1 to 4 without following the procedure prescribed therein did not pay any compensation to the petitioners for their said immovable properties, which compelled the petitioners to submit a representation before respondent 2 herein on 08.08.2022 as the said respondent 2 on 09.05.2022 notified the final award as also list dated 26.07.2022 of the "persons interested" entitled to the compensation wherein the petitioners did not figure.

3. Objections to the petition have been filed by the respondents herein, wherein it is being admitted that the acquisition proceedings came to be undertaken for construction of the Delhi-Amritsar-Katra Expressway under in terms of the provisions of the National Highway Act,
1956, and that a final award in the matter came to be passed by the Collector respondent 2 herein on 09.05.2022, so is also being admitted the notifying of the names of the "persons interested" found entitled for payment of compensation excluding the petitioners herein.

The receipt of the representation submitted by the petitioners on 08.08.2022 for payment of the compensation for their immovable properties acquired in the process before respondent 2 is also admitted.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
4. It is not in dispute that the proceedings undertaken by the respondents herein for land acquisition have been taken recourse to under the provisions of the National Highway Act, 1956.

Section 3H of the said Act relating to the deposit and payment of amount provides for resolving the claim of a person interested in the amount deposited under sub section (1) by the competent authority, so also,
does section 3H envisage a mechanism for resolving of a dispute relating to the apportionment of the amount or any part thereof to any person to whom the same or any part thereof is payable by making of a reference by the competent authority of the dispute to the decision of the principal civil court of original jurisdiction within the limits of whose jurisdiction the property is situated.

Since in the instant case, the petitioners claim to be "persons interested"
and entitled to the amount of compensation for the immovable properties claimed to have been acquired by the respondents herein and indisputably also have approached respondent 2 wherein for addressing to their said claim, it was incumbent upon respondent 2 herein being the competent authority under the Act of 1956 to have made a reference in this regard in terms of section 3H of the said Act of 1956 to the decision of the concerned court of original jurisdiction and same, however, having not been done by respondent 2 herein, this Court under these circumstances deem it appropriate to dispose of the instant petition with a direction to respondent 2 herein to deal with the representation of the petitioners pending before him since 08.08.2022 in accordance with the provisions of the law applicable thereto without any further delay and in the said process, while proceeding as above, shall also afford an opportunity of hearing to all "persons interested" besides the petitioners including the respondents 5 to 7 herein.
